title: machilus arunachalensis
intro: Machilus arunachalensis, commonly known as the Arunachal machilus, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It is a shrub or small tree that is native to the Northeast Indian states. The health benefits of Machilus arunachalensis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, headache, and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
